title: Measurement bench: sample to reviewed DistroFit analysis
purpose: Keep sample identity, instrument checks and held measurements traceable before comparing distributions. This is a synthetic example to adapt and approve locally.

steps.title: Receive and identify samples
steps.instruction: Record the batch and sample IDs. Put incoming samples in the labelled incoming tray. Separate unknown or damaged samples for review.

steps.title: Prepare the bench with the 6S checklist
steps.instruction: Remove unnecessary items, return tools to labelled homes, clean measuring surfaces and confirm access to guards and emergency equipment. Record findings and resolve unsafe conditions before work.

steps.title: Instrument and method ready?
steps.instruction: Check instrument identity, calibration status, units and the current approved measurement method. Confirm the area is safe to operate.
steps.record: Instrument ID, calibration status and method revision

steps.title: Hold the samples and resolve the issue
steps.instruction: Label and segregate held samples. Record the issue, responsible role and due date. Use a suitable instrument or obtain the required review before rechecking readiness.
steps.record: Hold log and corrective action evidence

steps.title: Measure and record original values
steps.instruction: Follow the approved method. Record sample IDs, original readings and units without replacing the originals. Keep held and accepted samples in separate labelled locations.

steps.title: Measurement log complete and valid?
steps.instruction: Check sample identity, units, transcription and method compliance. Investigate unusual readings; do not delete them only to improve the fitted curve.
steps.record: Review notes and any exclusions with reasons

steps.title: Resolve missing or questionable readings
steps.instruction: Retain the original log and document the reason for corrections or repeat measurements. Keep affected samples on hold until the reviewer accepts the record.

steps.title: Compare curves in DistroFit
steps.instruction: Load accepted numeric values, confirm units, choose a held-out fraction and compare fitted curves. Use SPC for time-ordered process checks; record preprocessing and limits before interpreting results.
steps.record: Saved DistroFit comparison with input data and settings

steps.title: Archive the reviewed result and reset the bench
steps.instruction: Save the reviewed report with the batch record. Return tools and reference samples, clean the area and schedule follow-up on 6S actions. A fitted curve does not authorize product release.
steps.record: Reviewed analysis, bench reset and follow-up record
